subject.title: fix: support baseURL alias in memory embedding provider config resolution

question: Should OpenClaw accept `models.providers.*.baseURL` as a core input-only compatibility alias for canonical `baseUrl`?
rationale: Provider endpoint config controls routing, credentials, redaction, and network trust, so automation cannot decide whether this broader alias should become a supported core contract.

options.title: Accept input-only alias after review
options.body: Land the alias only at parse time, keep runtime output canonical as `baseUrl`, and preserve the redaction/docs/test coverage.

options.title: Keep core schema canonical only
options.body: Decline or pause this PR and require core provider config to use `baseUrl`, leaving plugin-owned aliases where already supported.

options.title: Coordinate with broader routing PR
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose one landing path for the overlapping memory endpoint-routing fixes.

recommendation.title: Accept input-only alias after review
recommendation.body: Land the alias only at parse time, keep runtime output canonical as `baseUrl`, and preserve the redaction/docs/test coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the memory, net-policy, and Ollama alias surfaces affected by this decision.
